status: confirmed boundary-condition difference in the completed legacy baseline; response sensitivity remains unquantified

actual_core_x_restraint.position: interior first-row node, about8.1mm above the lower core boundary

numerical_assessment: Explicit time integration has a nonsingular mass-based update without fixing an in-plane core translation solely to invert a static stiffness matrix.
An interior fixed X displacement can constrain local lateral buckling/drift; it is not a neutral static gauge once frictional contact and nonuniform deformation are present.
Removing it is a justified boundary-condition sensitivity case. The completed baseline must remain labelled as using this interior pin.
No stress reduction, mode agreement, or explanation of the full paper discrepancy is claimed without an actual unpinned comparison.
preservation: The completed baseline deck/hash are retained as historical evidence. Updating a writer default does not change its recorded inputs or retrospectively validate it.
